lesson: In tools/build-page.js exportVideo, a MediaRecorder stopped straight after the last writer.write() drops the frame still in its encoder, so count frames from the written file with webmBlockTimes, never from the write loop.

For exportVideo in tools/build-page.js, a browser check run headless with --disable-gpu is not the browser the owner uses: the one-lap hold passed there and lost 1 to 2 frames in headed Edge with the GPU on, so verify a MediaRecorder change in a headed window with the GPU on.
